# A chunk of snowball: a faceted lump 0.5 m, cream and peach. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Snow --base-color 1.000 0.965 0.827 --no-slot
material new Packed --base-color 0.976 0.659 0.459 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name Chunk --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.25 --rotation 10 20 30
material assign Snow
active Chunk
mode edit
select face where "normal.x > 0.3"
material assign Packed
mode object
shade flat
export chunk.glb
